surface_mechanism_description: The surface reaction mechanism involves the sequential adsorption and reaction of copper acetylacetonate (Cu(acac)2) and hydrogen sulfide (H2S) to form Cu-S* species, followed by the adsorption and reaction of trimethylaluminum (TMA) and H2S to form Al-S* species. These surface species then react to form Cu-O-Al(CH3)2 and release CH4.
evidence: The text describes the ALD process for synthesizing Cu-S:Al-S thin films using Cu(acac)2, TMA, and H2S. The surface reactions involve the formation of Cu-S* and Al-S* species, which then react to form Cu-O-Al(CH3)2 and release CH4. The specific chemical equations and intermediate species are derived from the detailed description of the ALD process and the chemical interactions between the precursors and the surface.
